title: Markov processes forced on a subspace by a large drift, with applications to population genetics
summary: Consider a sequence of Markov processes $X^1, X^2,...$ with state space $E$, where $X^N$ has a strong drift to $D \subseteq E$, such that $Φ(X^N)$ is slow for some appropriate $Φ: E\to D$. Using the method of martingale problems, we give a limit result, such that $Φ(X^N) \xRightarrow{N\to\infty} Z$ in the space of càdlàg paths, and $X^N \xRightarrow{N\to\infty} X$ in measure. \\ We apply the general limit result to models for copy number variation of genetic elements in a diploid Moran model of size $N$.
